premises.text: Outbreak response fails when diagnostics are slow: patients backlog for months and infection status stays unknown
premises.evidence_span: Patients are waiting months to get their results back

premises.text: Existing tools trade off portability and sensitivity or cost: dipsticks miss early cases; PCR is sensitive but expensive and not near-patient
FastChip vacuum microwell chemistry amplifies DNA/RNA without external equipment and reads quantitative fluorescence with a smartphone in about an hour
premises.evidence_span: no external equipment such as pumps, controllers, computers, and valves are necessary

premises.text: Trackable GPS/patient/results app plus phased research-to-FDA launch supports decentralized outbreak response
premises.evidence_span: So this becomes a powerful disease tracking network

value.text: Fight epidemics with rapid accessible molecular diagnostics near the patient
value.evidence_span: Our mission is to fight epidemics with rapid molecular diagnostics

secondary_value.text: Impact millions of lives across Zika and future outbreaks
secondary_value.evidence_span: technology that can potentially impact millions of lives
